text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I still can't accept this!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Are you exceptionally sensitive, or do you simply possess an unusually strong sense of justice? I wonder.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-kun.
No, it's really nothing of consequence.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It's just, a moment ago there were some Umamusume talking about me. And what they said was—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It's awful! They're saying Tachyon-san
is a dangerous person who makes weird drugs!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
As her Trainer, don't you also find
that kind of backstabbing unforgivable!?
choice_data_list: Talking behind people's backs isn't nice.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Right?!
We really should be careful here—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Stop it, it's a waste of time.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Above all, I don't mind at all.
It's a phenomenon entirely unrelated to my research, after all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Besides,
it's not like I'm trying to gain more sympathizers—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying?!
It's way too heartbreaking to leave it as a misunderstanding!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, let's not get agitated. Here, I know,
I shall brew you some soothing tea.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Now, follow me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. Thank you for the tea.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It had an interesting, slightly tingling kick to it,
but it was delicious.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see.
That is good to hear.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Still... I just can't accept
what happened earlier.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
To make fun of someone who's giving their all
for their dream...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... You truly are earnest.
What do you think, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Let's prove them wrong with our research!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "I don't really care about proving anyone wrong, but as an approach, it's not bad."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Yes, that's right.
Proving it with real results is the best way, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I...
I shouldn't have meddled.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Come now, it's no problem at all!
Here, keep your head up and look forward.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
When you're feeling down,
for some reason, I just can't seem to settle down.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
Thank you very much, Tachyon-san!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well then... sorry for staying so long.
Thank you for the tea!
Daiwa Scarlet headed back, seemingly convinced... but.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: How strange... I specifically laced it with a potion that extends nerves into the hair to make it move in response to emotions.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Originally,
they were supposed to stand on end whenever I got mad."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I couldn't see any difference at all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I hoped it would be a step forward in my physical transformation, but it's another failure! Haha!
I couldn't help but wonder if they were a dangerous person after all, but―

From her exchange with Daiwa Scarlet,
it seemed Agnes Tachyon managed to learn something.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
My amazing side, you say...
Are you telling me to show off the fruits of my research?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That's it!
Don't you have any recent experiments that succeeded!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm... A curveball, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: A curve?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Glasses that can calculate a comfortable course
that puts less strain on muscles when taking corners...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Incredible!! Isn't that totally amazing?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"You probably shouldn't use it during a race,
but if you can use it to memorize and master the course...!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No, that may be true,
but there is still room for improvement—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Let's do it! Let's do it right away!
We'll show those girls what we're made of!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Right?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A-All right, all right.
...You're pretty intense, you know.

Overwhelmed by Daiwa Scarlet's fierce momentum,
Agnes Tachyon pulled an all-nighter to finish the glasses—

She had successfully mastered
splendid cornering technique.
